arStrings.szText:
Sacrificing both Skeletal Warriors and Golems grants an additional Skeletal Mage for each Minion sacrificed.

When a Skeletal Mage attacks enemies {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} times without dying it upgrades to a Skeletal Arch-Mage.

Skeletal Arch-Mages teleport to safety when attacked and their attacks occasionally shatter on impact dealing {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to the target and up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} additional targets.
